question: Q-W-M2-D3
text: Compare closing stock on hand at 2015-12-31 and 2014-12-31 by selling package and chiller flag.
interpretation: Closing stock on hand at 2015-12-31 vs 2014-12-31 by selling package and chiller flag (as-was item attributes).
assemble: SELECT selling_package, is_chiller_stock, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE '2014-12-31' THEN closing_units END) AS closing_units_2014, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE '2015-12-31' THEN closing_units END) AS closing_units_2015, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE '2015-12-31' THEN closing_units END) - MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_date = DATE '2014-12-31' THEN closing_units END) AS change_units FROM q WHERE snap_rows > 0 GROUP BY selling_package, is_chiller_stock ORDER BY selling_package, is_chiller_stock
